name: QMPSB
summary: QMPSB is an arylsulfonamide-based synthetic cannabinoid that has been sold as a designer drug.

pharmacology.text: It acts as a full agonist of the CB1 receptor and CB2 receptor with Ki values of 3 nM and 4 nM, respectively. Many related derivatives were subsequently produced, with the main focus of this work being to increase selectivity for the non-psychoactive CB2 receptor.

uses.text: QMPSB is an arylsulfonamide-based synthetic cannabinoid that has been sold as a designer drug.

summaryZh: QMPSB是一種含氮有機硫化合物，分子式C22H22N2O4S，具有大麻素受體激動劑的作用，在黑市上以策劃藥銷售。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Synthetic cannabinoids as a group can cause anxiety, paranoia, a racing heart, vomiting, confusion and psychosis, and have been linked to seizures, kidney injury, heart attacks and deaths. Regular use can lead to dependence and difficult withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。合成大麻素整體而言可能引起焦慮、偏執、心跳過快、嘔吐、意識混亂和精神病症狀，也曾與癲癇發作、腎損傷、心臟病發作和死亡有關。規律使用可能導致依賴和難熬的戒斷症狀。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。合成大麻素整体而言可能引起焦虑、偏执、心跳过快、呕吐、意识混乱和精神病症状，也曾与癫痫发作、肾损伤、心脏病发作和死亡有关。规律使用可能导致依赖和难熬的戒断症状。

fact.en: Most synthetic cannabinoids are built on an indole or indazole core, but QMPSB is an arylsulfonamide, a quite different shape that still fits the CB1 receptor.
fact.zh: 多數合成大麻素以吲哚或吲唑為核心，但 QMPSB 屬於芳基磺醯胺，形狀相當不同，卻仍能與 CB1 受體結合。
fact.zhHans: 多数合成大麻素以吲哚或吲唑为内核，但 QMPSB 属于芳基磺酰胺，形状相当不同，却仍能与 CB1 受体结合。
